import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
n = 600
track_ids = np.repeat(np.arange(30), 20)
times = np.tile(np.arange(20), 30).astype(float)
df = pd.DataFrame({'x': rng.normal(track_ids * 0.5, 0.3, n), 'y': rng.normal(0, 1, n), 'track_id': track_ids, 'time': times})

steps.name: request tracks
steps.eval: const idCol = a.describe.columns.find(c => c.name === 'track_id'); const tCol = a.describe.columns.find(c => c.name === 'time'); a.requestTracks(idCol.index, tCol.index)

steps.name: tracks rendered — check for colored pixels
steps.eval: const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r=>{img.onload=r;img.src=url}); const cv=document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width=img.width; cv.height=img.height; const g=cv.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(img,0,0); const d=g.getImageData(0,0,cv.width,cv.height).data; let n=0; for(let k=0;k<d.length;k+=4) if(d[k]+d[k+1]+d[k+2]>60) n++; window.__trackPixels=n

steps.name: track pixels with the points hidden (baseline)
steps.eval: a.updateLayer('base', { visible: false }); a.render(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); a.updateLayer('base', { visible: true }); a.render(); const img = new Image(); await new Promise((r) => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.width; c.height = img.height; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = g.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let n = 0, r = 0, b = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) if (d[k] + d[k + 1] + d[k + 2] > 60) { n++; r += d[k]; b += d[k + 2]; } window.__t0 = { n, r, b };

steps.name: hiding the tracks layer in the layer list removes them
steps.eval: a.updateLayer('tracks', { visible: false }); a.updateLayer('base', { visible: false }); a.render(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); a.updateLayer('base', { visible: true }); a.render(); const img = new Image(); await new Promise((r) => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.width; c.height = img.height; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = g.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let n = 0, r = 0, b = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) if (d[k] + d[k + 1] + d[k + 2] > 60) { n++; r += d[k]; b += d[k + 2]; } window.__t1 = { n }; a.updateLayer('tracks', { visible: true }); a.render();

steps.name: colour by time changes the track colours
steps.eval: a.setTracksOptions({ colorBy: 'time' }); a.updateLayer('base', { visible: false }); a.render(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); a.updateLayer('base', { visible: true }); a.render(); const img = new Image(); await new Promise((r) => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.width; c.height = img.height; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = g.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let n = 0, r = 0, b = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) if (d[k] + d[k + 1] + d[k + 2] > 60) { n++; r += d[k]; b += d[k + 2]; } window.__t2 = { n, r, b };
steps.assert: Math.abs(window.__t2.r / window.__t2.n - window.__t0.r / window.__t0.n) > 5 || Math.abs(window.__t2.b / window.__t2.n - window.__t0.b / window.__t0.n) > 5

steps.name: fading tail makes older segments fainter (fewer bright pixels)
steps.eval: a.setTracksOptions({ colorBy: 'id', fadingTail: true }); a.updateLayer('base', { visible: false }); a.render(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); a.updateLayer('base', { visible: true }); a.render(); const img = new Image(); await new Promise((r) => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.width; c.height = img.height; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = g.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let n = 0, r = 0, b = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) if (d[k] + d[k + 1] + d[k + 2] > 60) { n++; r += d[k]; b += d[k + 2]; } window.__t3 = { n };
